text:
mina_cloud: flagged by infra-audit: an IAM role trust policy for role `repo-deployer` allowed OIDC issuance from `token.actions.githubusercontent.com` with no repository restriction. This means any public GH Actions runner could assume it if they could push a workflow.

alex_security: wow. that's bad. which role ARN and when was the policy last changed?

mina_cloud: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/repo-deployer. Policy change detected 2026-03-27T09:14:22 by infra-automation.

ben_devsec: can you paste the trust snippet?

mina_cloud: snippet we saw (audit):
```
"Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"},
"Condition": {}
```
No `StringLike` on `sub` restricting to org/repo.

ryan_ops: immediate risk: CI runners or a forked repo with a malicious workflow could mint STS creds and deploy. We need emergency lock down.

ci-bot: [automated] Created ticket S-5805: "Lock down repo-deployer OIDC trust + rotate any tokens issued" assigned to cloud & infra (Priority: P0). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/S-5805

security-bot: [automated] Starting retroactive credential issuance audit for role/repo-deployer. ETA ~20m.

alex_security: mitigation actions (do now):
- mina_cloud: add `StringLike` condition restricting `sub` to `repo:your-org/*` and require `aud: sts.amazonaws.com`
- ryan_ops: revoke any active sessions/assumed-role tokens for repo-deployer and rotate any static deploy keys that rely on it
- ben_devsec: scan public workflows in GitHub orgs for accidental ability to assume role (look for `id-token: write`) and create fail gate in our templates

mina_cloud: applying policy change now: updated trust with `"Condition": {"StringLike": {"token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub": "repo:redwood/*"}}`. Pushed and applied.

ryan_ops: running `aws iam list-role-policies` and `sts get-caller-identity` audit for the last 48h to find tokens minted. If we find any usage, we'll revoke and redeploy.

security-bot: [automated] Audit complete: 9 assume-role events from distinct OIDC tokens in the last 7 days. 2 of those originated from forks in external repos (suspicious). Creating follow-ups inside S-5805.

ben_devsec: PR ready to enforce OIDC restricted templates in all CI starter repos and to add `require-approver` step for any workflow that requests `id-token: write`. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ci-templates/pull/99

ryan_ops: temporarily revoked inline policy allowing `sts:AssumeRole` for `repo-deployer` from federation while we confirm each assume event. Revocation done at 2026-03-27T10:02:13 UTC.

mina_cloud: created a scoped replacement role `repo-deployer-scope` with explicit repo restriction and minimal S3/Deploy rights for known deploy workflows. Will transition CI in phases.

alex_security: compliance / risk notes: list of affected deploys and potential external IPs that used the tokens requested by GHA needed for severity classification. Attach to S-5805.

security-bot: [automated] Found 2 suspicious assume-role events tied to forks: actions from user forks that requested id-token and then called deploy endpoints. Marked for manual review.

ben_devsec: added lint rule to fail if `permissions: {id-token: write}` appears without codeowner approval. Also adding a nightly job to scan for trust policies missing `sub` restrictions.

ryan_ops: running a mitigation checklist: rotate any deploy credentials minted by the role, verify artifact integrity for the flagged deploys, and rollback any untrusted changes. So far no production rollback required; 1 non-prod deploy from a fork was observed and rolled back.

mina_cloud: timeline: immediate lock applied (done), full audit & rotation in 24h, remediation and CI template enforcement in 72h. Postmortem owner: infra-automation (assigned in S-5805).

alex_security: please escalate to legal if we confirm external code triggered a deploy. Also notify partner integrators if any of their repos were implicated.

ci-bot: [automated] Added checklist items to S-5805 and assigned reviewers.

security-bot: [automated] Retro-scan scheduled weekly for OIDC trust looseness.

mina_cloud: wrapping up this thread. Follow-ups live in S-5805. If you spot any other roles with empty `sub` conditions DM me. :rotating_light:
